Configure current feature

  1. Create guild roles/invites/membership schema and WBP_Guild; configure bounded membership30as a proposal and no shared item bank.
  2. Add support/moderation dashboards and durable permission audit. Keep DA_Mount_Prototype disabled until mounted art, collision, network movement and water/gate behavior pass separately.

Run now: current-phase integrated scenarios

  1. A creates guild, invites B, promotes/removes a member and reconnects from another zone. Verify capability checks for each role.
  2. Attempt duplicate invitation/acceptance and disband with concurrent membership change; inspect guild revision and receipt.
  3. Exercise maintenance/support workflow using redacted account/command IDs and least-privilege credentials.
Expected success
Guild membership/roles persist, unauthorized actions reject and no new item economy is introduced by guild UI.
Mount gate remains visibly disabled unless its independent art/runtime proof is actually attached.

Explicitly not active yet

  1. Mounts remain a committed feasibility-gated later system, not existing art or enabled production feature. Guild banks/raids are not assumed.

Expected rejection and concurrency results

SystemStimulus -> expected outcome
current-phase fixtureNonofficer promotion, stale guild revision and duplicate membership reject. Account deletion/recovery resolves membership explicitly.

Regression, disconnect and restart

  1. Restart the test environment twice; one admitted pawn per account, one local input context installation, no stale widgets.
  2. Repeat the previous phase success case after all new assignments; definitions missing from this phase must fail closed, not fall back to client saves.
  3. From phase03 onward run two separate clients; disconnect A while B remains, then reconnect with the correct identity.
  4. From phase05 onward query committed receipt/revision after timeout/restart. From06 onward reject old source epoch after transfer.

Stop condition and deferred work

Guild mutations are authorized and versioned; no unverified mounted art is enabled.

Stop on a failed required assertion, missing required rule definition, duplicate authority or unverified dependency that this phase relies on. Legal debug art may support physics tests but cannot close the archive/PaperZD art gate. Do not activate future-phase systems merely because their full-game chapter exists.
